title: Zesty Braised German Pork Knuckle Casserole
description: A pungent and aerated solo-dinner German dish featuring pork knuckle, this casserole is ovo-vegetarian-friendly and perfect for a hearty meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the Sauerkraut, Dijon mustard, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Return the pork knuckle to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 hours.
While the pork is braising, whisk together the egg and sour cream in a bowl.
After 2 hours, remove the pot from the oven and stir in the egg and sour cream mixture.
Return the pot to the oven and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes.
